verdict.rationale: Authenticator documents its own Export Passwords feature, which produces an export file you can import into another provider. That covers only one slice of the data, though: the backup for OTP accounts is a cloud backup for restoring into Authenticator, passkeys are device-bound and never leave the device, and community reports say password autofill (and its export path) is being discontinued. missing for 10: a documented export of OTP/TOTP secrets, any stated open file format for the password export, export of passkeys and Verified IDs, a full-data export, independent corroboration that exports migrate cleanly.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Scroll down to the Autofill section and select Export Passwords.
Once you have imported your passwords to another provider, ensure the export file is deleted.
Passkeys in the Authenticator app are device-bound to ensure that they never leave the device they were created on.
